about.title: Great nights should feel effortless
about.subtitle: Booking Nhanh was created to make premium private karaoke simpler, warmer and more transparent.
about.storyTitle: A better way to come together
about.storyOne: We started with a simple idea: booking a great room for the people you love should not involve confusing prices, endless calls or uncertainty.
about.storyTwo: Today, every Booking Nhanh space combines considered design, current technology and genuine Vietnamese hospitality. From the first click to the final song, our team keeps the experience smooth.
about.valueOneText: Every decision starts with making your night easier, safer and more enjoyable.
about.valueTwoText: Clear information and transparent pricing mean you always know what to expect.
about.valueThreeText: From microphone checks to room lighting, the small things create the best memories.
